newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ lists criteria for managing planned RSS funds.
newsitem.headline: NZ lists criteria for managing planned RSS funds.

text.p: The New Zealand government on Monday said fund managers who wanted to handle funds for the newly-proposed compulsory Retirement Savings Scheme (RSS) would need to fulfil certain criteria.
These included paying tax on earnings from the funds, ensuring that funds were portable and diversified and could not be withdrawn early. Funds would have to be held at arms length.
A government White Paper launched on Monday also confirmed that the state does not intend to guarantee funds placed by individuals with the private sector.
A referendum is due on the scheme in September.
